overload.scope: finite exact-run single-cord pressure and recovery; persistent ownership is measured separately

fanout.scope: finite exact-run coupled atomic publication and isolated ordinary-duplicator publication with one profile-accounted retained value

cancellation.scope: finite exact-run cancellation requested after block pressure begins

bursty_consumers.scope: finite exact runs alternating explicit cooperative consumer pauses and bounded consume bursts

persistent_sessions.scope: production ExactRunSession ownership through repeated bounded host pumps; Block stops with the final offer pending under pressure, while non-blocking policies stop from the standing source's observation boundary

persistent_wake_residency.scope: one production ExactRunSession waits for and consumes one exact host-operation wake per value without resetting; queue, payload, ready, and evidence high-water values at the declared checkpoint must equal those after the final wake

persistent_timer_residency.scope: one production ExactRunSession advances to and consumes one exact retained timer deadline per value without resetting; queue, payload, ready, and evidence high-water values at the declared checkpoint must equal those after the final wake

strict_invariants: every runner emits the current raw-sample schema and fixture revision
offered and admitted values equal configured input values for the lossless local-depth fixtures
offered, admitted, completed-useful, rejected, sampled, coalesced, dropped, cancelled, retried, and terminal outcomes are always reported separately
Conduit reports exact scheduler decisions and producer stall duration; Drain and Abort timing stay unavailable until those transitions are explicitly requested
pressured Drain preserves every retained admitted value while pressured Abort may discard retained admitted work and neither coalesced replacement nor aborted work counts as useful
bursty consumers report exact repeated pressure and recovery cycle counts without a hidden timing source or buffer
persistent rows retain one finite session reservation across bounded host pumps, request termination with admitted work still pressured, and release the reservation only after terminal finalization

persistent host-operation and timer residency rows perform the declared deterministic wake count without resetting the session, allocate zero times after Start, reach a strict internal high-water plateau, and reconcile the session reservation after Drain finalization
bounded FIFO retries in local-depth fixtures are reported and do not change admitted or completed-useful counts
map, merge, and bounded-async complete one useful output per input
map-filter completes one useful output per input until it contains a filter, then exactly half for the even input cardinality
all sampled values have a positive latency
Conduit does not allocate after Start and never exceeds its exact queue, value, or evidence reservation
overload queue item high water never exceeds the declared capacity
overload accounting conserves offered values according to the exact pressure policy
block, reject, coalesce, sample, and disposable-drop fixtures enter a slow region and then clear into a recovery region
coupled fan-out admits each input atomically to every branch or retries without partial publication
isolated fan-out uses an explicit ordinary duplicator and reports its one retained input through the execution profile
fan-out useful completion equals admitted inputs multiplied by exact branch count
aggregate fan-out queue high water never exceeds capacity multiplied by branch count

wall_clock_policy.summary: median with deterministic percentile-bootstrap 95% confidence interval over measured trials
